mapper.select:
select t1.ID_, t1.PROC_INST_ID_, t1.ASSIGNEE_, t2.NAME_ PROCESS_NAME, t1.NAME_, t3.START_USER_ID_, t1.CREATE_TIME_ from act_ru_task t1, act_re_procdef t2, act_ru_execution t3 where t1.PROC_DEF_ID_ = t2.ID_ and t1.PROC_INST_ID_ = t3.PROC_INST_ID_ and t3.PARENT_ID_ is null
and t1.ID_ = #{taskId}
select TEXT_ from act_hi_varinst where PROC_INST_ID_=#{process_id} and NAME_='documentName'
select TEXT_ from act_hi_varinst where PROC_INST_ID_=#{process_id} and NAME_='documentName' and TEXT_ like concat(concat('%',#{document_name}),'%')
select ID_,PROC_INST_ID_,BUSINESS_KEY_ from act_ru_execution where PROC_INST_ID_=#{process_id}
mapper.delete: delete act_ru_execution b where b.id_ in ( select a1.id_ from act_ru_execution a1 ,act_hi_actinst a2 where a1.act_id_=a2.act_id_ and a1.proc_inst_id_=#{process_id} and a2.act_type_='parallelGateway' and a1.id_=a2.execution_id_ and a1.is_mi_root_=0)
mapper.select: select TEXT_ from act_ru_variable arv where arv.proc_inst_id_=#{process_id} and NAME_='pName'

SELECT ahp.proc_inst_id_ id, (select art.id_ from act_ru_task art where art.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_ and rownum = 1) task_id, ahp.start_time_ start_time, ahp.end_time_ end_time, (select su.description from sys_user su, sys_user_allocation sua where su.user_id = sua.user_id and sua.allocation_id = ahp.start_user_id_) start_user_name, (select to_char(wm_concat(to_char(su.description))) from act_ru_task art, sys_user su, sys_user_allocation sua where art.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_ and sua.allocation_id = art.assignee_ and sua.enabled_flag = 'Y' and sua.user_id = su.user_id) current_approver, (SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su, ACT_HI_COMMENT COMM, sys_user_allocation sua where su.user_id = sua.user_id and to_char(sua.allocation_id) = COMM.USER_ID_ and COMM.PROC_INST_ID_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_ and comm.type_ = 'action' and rownum = 1 and comm.time_ = (SELECT MAX(AHC.TIME_) FROM ACT_HI_COMMENT AHC WHERE AHC.TYPE_ = 'action' AND AHC.PROC_INST_ID_= ahp.proc_inst_id_) and not exists (select 1 from act_ru_task art where art.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_)) last_approver, (select ahv.text_ from act_hi_varinst ahv where ahv.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_ and ahv.name_ = 'documentName') document_name, (select ahv.text_ from act_hi_varinst ahv where ahv.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_ and ahv.name_ = 'documentNumber') document_number, (select arm.name_ from ACT_RE_PROCDEF arp,act_re_model arm where arp.id_ = ahp.proc_def_id_ and arp.key_ = arm.key_) process_name, (select arp.key_ from ACT_RE_PROCDEF arp where arp.id_ = ahp.proc_def_id_) process_code, decode(ahp.end_time_, null, '运行中', '已结束') as process_status FROM act_hi_procinst ahp
and ahp.start_user_id_ = (select sua.allocation_id from sys_user_allocation sua where sua.user_id = #{request.userId})
and exists (select 1 from act_hi_identitylink ahi,sys_user_allocation sua where ahi.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_ and sua.user_id = #{request.userId} and to_char(sua.allocation_id) = ahi.user_id_)
exists (select 1 from act_hi_identitylink ahi,sys_user_allocation sua where ahi.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_ and sua.user_id = #{request.userId} and to_char(sua.allocation_id) = ahi.user_id_)
and to_date(#{started_after},'YYYY-MM-DD') <= ahp.start_time_
and to_date(#{started_before},'YYYY-MM-DD') >= ahp.start_time_
and to_date(#{finished_after},'YYYY-MM-DD') <= ahp.end_time_
and to_date(#{finished_before},'YYYY-MM-DD') >= ahp.end_time_
AND (select ahv.text_ from act_hi_varinst ahv where ahv.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_ and ahv.name_ = 'documentName') LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{document_name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND (select ahv.text_ from act_hi_varinst ahv where ahv.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_ and ahv.name_ = 'documentNumber') LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{document_number,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND (select arm.name_ from ACT_RE_PROCDEF arp,act_re_model arm where arp.id_ = ahp.proc_def_id_ and arp.key_ = arm.key_) LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{process_name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND exists (select 1 from act_ru_task art where art.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_)
AND not exists (select 1 from act_ru_task art where art.proc_inst_id_ = ahp.proc_inst_id_)
and ahp.proc_inst_id_ = #{process_id}
and ahp.proc_inst_id_ in
#{item,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
and 1!=1
order by to_number(ahp.id_) desc
